collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager wakes up grumpy for no reason as a friend arrives far too cheerful: say so, or try to be pleasant.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) woke up grumpy. Nothing happened. (subject.He/she) slept fine. The weather is lovely. Everyone is being perfectly nice. (subject.He/she) is grumpy anyway, from the top of (subject.his/her) head to the soles of (subject.his/her) feet. And here comes (friend), smiling, saying "Good morning!" in a voice that is far too cheerful for anyone to be using this early.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "I'm grumpy today," says (subject). "It's not you. It's nothing. I'm just grumpy." (friend) nods seriously. "Understood." For the rest of the day (friend) greets (subject.him/her) with a solemn, silent nod, as if passing an elder at a very serious ceremony. By evening, (subject) is still grumpy and also laughing, which is very annoying.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Good morning," says (subject), with a smile that hurts. (subject.He/she) is pleasant all day. It's exhausting. By evening (subject.he/she) is grumpier than ever. (subject.He/she) goes to bed early and wakes up the next morning feeling fine, for no reason at all, which is somehow the most annoying part.
